title: Shape pattern to label
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Cleanliness, shapes and numbers to 20
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: shape pattern to label)
intro: Lesson 10: Shapes: دَائِرَة، مُرَبَّع، مُثَلَّث. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Shapes in Islamic art
points: Islamic patterns use circles and stars

blocks.text: Write the Arabic shape name inside each shape, then count how many of each.

questions.q: Hold up a square shape and say it with its colour.
questions.a: For example: مُرَبَّعٌ أَزْرَقُ (a blue square)

questions.q: How many sides has a مُثَلَّث?
Colour and label the pattern on the pupil PDF: write the Arabic shape name in each shape and count how many of each.
questions.a: Shapes labelled correctly; counts written as Arabic numbers

questions.q: Stretch: why is the colour حَمْرَاء with دَائِرَة?
questions.a: دَائِرَة is a girl word (ends in ة), so the colour is the girl form.
A) Triangle. مُثَلَّث has three sides (ثَلَاثَة = three).

questions.q: Think again: which shape is most in your room?
